tweet.text:
Extremely excited to share that we just launched Grok Bot! Bots do work on their own computers while you're at meetings, while you're having lunch, and while you sleep.

I've been using Grok Bot to manage my calendar and ship code. My team of bots also help me with my personal life, including finding me tickets to The Odyssey in IMAX 70mm, ordering me lunch everyday, and finding me dank emojis to upload to Slack. It's a claw that Just Works.

I'm also really proud of the client architecture for Grok Bot. It started life as a quick and loose prototype, but over the past few weeks, I've completely refactored it to be built on top of a new agent friendly framework I've been building that I'm currently codenaming "Dune" (working title). 

It's designed for agents, even the ones who have very little context, to write high quality code by default. It's still early but I've been really impressed by how well Dune has been holding up with the barrage of PRs leading up to the launch. The Grok Bot client is super smooth and buttery.

Download Grok Bot, give it a try and let us know what you think!
